title: Village Sports Timing & Record Dashboard
problem: Talented village sprinters and kabaddi players lose sports quota chances because no one keeps proper timing records of their achievements.
idea: A sports record maker. Enter the race distance and time and it calculates speed and compares with the best time, so we can build player profile cards.

widgets.heading: 🧮 Try it: Record a race
widgets.intro: Use a phone stopwatch. Measure the track with a tape.
widgets.formula: if (!(distance > 0 && time > 0)) return null; var ms = distance / time; var kmh = ms * 3.6; var msg, lvl; if (best > 0 && time < best) { msg = 'NEW PERSONAL BEST! ' + (best - time).toFixed(2) + ' seconds faster! 🏆'; lvl = 'good'; } else if (best > 0) { msg = 'Not a new best yet. ' + (time - best).toFixed(2) + ' seconds slower. Keep training!'; lvl = 'warn'; } else { msg = 'First record saved!'; lvl = 'good'; } return {ms: ms, kmh: kmh, msg: msg, level: lvl};

widgets.heading: ✅ Is the record official enough?
widgets.intro: Good records help in sports quota selection.

items.text: Track length measured with a tape
Timed with a stopwatch by a PE teacher or coach
Date, place and witness names written
Certificates from school/mandal meets kept in a file

bands.text: Strong record! Show it to coaches and selectors. 🏅
Good start. Add the missing proof.
Collect more proof so your talent is not missed.

how: Measure a 100 m track with your PE teacher.
In Scratch, make a timer using the 'timer' block: start on Space, stop on Enter.
Save each runner's name and time in a Scratch list.
Show the fastest time at the top as the record.
Ask Gemini to write a short player profile for each athlete.
Make player profile cards in Canva with photo, best time and achievements.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Write a short sports profile for a village sprinter: Name Lakshmi, age 15, 100 m best time 13.9 seconds, won 1st place in mandal-level meet 2025, also plays kabaddi. Keep it simple and proud.
